title: ODYSSEY：构建可验证的局部真值保持基础模型
summary: 提出一个名为ODYSSEY的范畴论框架，用于构建可验证的、保持局部真值的基础模型。该框架将模型构建为“foundries”（铸造厂）的组合，每个foundry是包含论证组件的知识层。通过通用铸造学习（UFL）和Foundry SQL（FSQL）实现形式化构建与查询，并在多种场景下验证。
summary_en: Introduces ODYSSEY, a categorical framework for constructing verifiable, local truth-preserving foundation models as compositions of foundries. It formalizes construction via Universal Foundry Learning (UFL) and Foundry SQL (FSQL), validated across diverse domains.
